title: ERC-4096: exact-gate robust label sampling with classical correlation decoding

claims.statement: For every integer N>=2 and s in Z/NZ, n=ceil(log2 N), ERC-4096 in proof.md acquires exactly m=4096(n+4) copies and recovers the entire s with unconditional probability at least 2/3, both on clean inputs and under the fifth claim's fixed-position product-clean/arbitrary-joint-bad error model with at most floor(m/64) malformed systems. The same fixed algorithm/configuration has worst-case total sequential work bound T(N,s)=O(N n^12), hence the uniform envelope T=O(2^n n^12) on every execution branch, with absolute outer constants independent of N,s,malformed states and outcomes. The representative envelope has exactly growth index 1. All source acquisitions, failed estimates, exact gate generation, bit arithmetic, addressing, initialization, circuits, registers and retained storage are charged in proof.md. All four resource statements, the error-fraction guarantee and full-secret success hold jointly. No record, historical novelty, frontier dominance or attainment of the 2^{O(n^(1/3))} research goal is asserted.

For every integer N>=2 and s in Z/NZ, n=ceil(log2 N), ERC-4096 in proof.md acquires exactly m=4096(n+4) copies and recovers the entire s with unconditional probability at least 2/3, both on clean inputs and under the fifth claim's fixed-position product-clean/arbitrary-joint-bad error model with at most floor(m/64) malformed systems. The guaranteed malformed fraction is epsilon(n)=1/64: at most floor(Q/64) of the actual Q=m acquired systems may be malformed under the structured error model below, with arbitrary joint states on those fixed positions and independent ideal copies elsewhere. For every such allowed input the same ERC-4096 configuration has unconditional full-secret success at least 2/3 jointly with all four all-branch resource bounds. This is a fraction of all acquired copies, not a corruption probability, and asserts no guarantee for adaptive replacement or a larger fraction.

structured.error_model: For m=4096(n+4) acquired n+1-qubit systems and n=ceil(log2 N), a set of malformed positions is fixed before private random choices. All remaining positions are independent ideal rho_s copies for the same s, tensor-product with an arbitrary joint state on the malformed positions. That state may depend on N,s and the fixed set, and may be entangled among malformed positions, but is independent of the clean copies and private random choices; there is no adaptive replacement based on private results. Malformed systems have the same register dimensions and may include unused residue labels. The fraction expression bounds the size of this fixed malformed set among all acquired copies.
